gloss: to rustle about; to rummage; to fumble around

definitions.gloss: to rustle about; to rummage; to fumble around
definitions.explanation: To make rustling sounds while searching through things or moving around restlessly. An onomatopoeic word describing the sound and action of rummaging.

examples.japanese: カバン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ごそごそした。
examples.english: I rummaged around in my bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ごそごそ→ごそごそ：05941_gosogoso⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear rustling sounds from the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{押|お}し{入|い}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ごそごそ→ごそごそ：05941_gosogoso⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}り→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: He rummaged around in the back of the closet and pulled out an old album.

notes:
An onomatopoeic (giongo) word that imitates the sound of rustling or shuffling. Can be used as ごそごそする (verb), ⟦ごそごそ→ごそごそ：05941_gosogoso⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (adverb with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧), or just ⟦ごそごそ→ごそごそ：05941_gosogoso⟧ (adverb without ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ごそごそ→ごそごそ：05941_gosogoso⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to rummage and search
- ⟦ごそごそ→ごそごそ：05941_gosogoso⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hear rustling sounds
- ⟦ごそごそ→ごそごそ：05941_gosogoso⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to move about restlessly
- ⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ごそごそする: to fumble in one's pocket

SIMILAR ONOMATOPOEIA:
- ⟦がさがさ→がさがさ：05986_gasagasa⟧: rustling — louder, rougher rustling sound
- もそもそ: mumbling/shuffling — slower, more muffled movement
- ⟦ごろごろ→ごろごろ：05176_gorogoro⟧: rolling/rumbling — heavier movement or thunder
